emma: Heads-up — got a support case where a customer sent a batch of vectors with mixed dims (512 + 1536) and got a 413. They expected an automatic split. What should our API semantics be here?
raj: We currently fast-fail mixed dims for the single-request path. Splitting happens in the splitter service but only when shape is consistent. 413 is coming from the runtime limit (payload bytes) not dim mismatch.
dion: Oh, interesting — so two separate failure modes are being conflated (shape vs bytes). We should surface separate errors. 
emma: Agree. Customer confusion is high. Can we send a clearer error like: "413 payload too large" vs "422 mixed vector dims — please split or use /batch-split"?
raj: +1 for distinct codes. 422 for shape contract makes sense. Also we have an internal header we can use for preflight: `X-Vector-Estimate-Units` — we could return suggested split plan in the error body.
marta: UX ask: console should show an inline suggested split and an "apply auto-split" toggle. Customers want one-click fixes.
dion: Telemetry note: when splitter autosplits we should emit `vectors.split.autosplit=true` and `vectors.split.strategy=dim` or `=byte`. That will help correlate with costs.
sre-jen: SLO side — autosplitting can increase token-equivalent cost and latency variance. We need circuit controls so Dedicated customers can opt-out (predictable billing).
emma: For Hosted API default -> autosplit by dim when dims are uniform in a batch; if mixed dims, default to rejection with 422 and suggested split. Optional header `X-Allow-Autosplit: true` to override.
raj: Implementation detail: runtime splitter needs to be idempotent and cheap. If we add `X-Allow-Autosplit`, splitter should return `X-Split-Plan: 2x(512),1x(1536)` and `X-Estimated-Units: 4608` in response headers.
dion: Also emit `metric:vector.request.estimated_units` with dimension histogram. Attach preflight sampling `prefetch:vector.shape_hint` to the trace.
marta: Console change: show "Estimated units", a breakdown bar (small vectors vs large), and an "auto-split" button that creates a suggested example request you can copy. Add a small warning icon for Dedicated accounts when autosplit is enabled.
sre-jen: Ops: if a lot of `X-Allow-Autosplit` requests hit us we should fallback to a cheaper quantized model variant automatically if latency budget exceeded — route policy `fallback:quant8-lowcost`. Need an opt-out at tenant-level.
emma: Action items: 1) API: introduce 422 for mixed-dims + structured body with split suggestion + `X-Allow-Autosplit` header. 2) Runtime: emit split headers & metrics. 3) Console: add estimate + apply-auto-split UX + Dedicated warning. 4) Docs/SDK: show example code + default behavior.
raj: I can prototype the header contract and error payload today. Will post a quick spec.
dion: I'll add telemetry events and a minimal dashboard tile: "autosplit rate", "avg estimated units", and "failures by shape".
marta: I'll sketch the console mock, will ping @design for microcopy.
sre-jen: I'll draft the tenant opt-out policy and flag for rollout. Also recommend a canary: 1% of hosted traffic with `X-Allow-Autosplit` enabled, record cost delta.
console-bot: deploy-bot: Canary stack for vectors-splitter scheduled — PR #8423 -> canary job queued :rocket:
emma: Thanks everyone — will follow up with the error JSON schema and a short customer-facing note. :thumbsup:
